description_en: Removes tags from a specified resource
description_zh: 调用UnTagResources为指定的资源解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc un-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --resource-id ehpc-hz-xxxx --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource from which you want to remove tags. Set the value to cluster, which indicates E-HPC clusters
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。目前仅支持cluster，即E-HPC集群
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. This parameter is valid only when the TagKey.N parameter is not specified. Valid values:

true
false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。当请求中未设置TagKey.N时，该参数才有效。取值范围：

true

false

默认值：false
parameters.name: all
